t: What Synthetic Biology Component Database Is All About
title: What Synthetic Biology Component Database Is All About
description: Synthetic biology treats DNA as engineering parts: promoters (transcription start signals), ribosome binding sites, coding sequences, terminators — snap them together like circuits. The iGEM Registry (partsregistry.org) standardized BioBrick parts; characterized parts carry datasheets: transfer curves, crosstalk, host range. The repressilator (2000) was the first synthetic oscillator: three repressors in a ring, blinking on schedule. This database is the complete biological part: full records with definitions, key facts, procedures, and runnable demo programs, organized on a teaching ladder from Foundations to Advanced.
